newsitem.title: DENMARK: Berendsen profit warning sends share down.
newsitem.headline: Berendsen profit warning sends share down.

text.p: A profits warning by Danish holding company Sophus Berendsen sent its share down by a hefty four percent on Monday.
At 1250 GMT the share was down 40 crowns to 686 crowns, but dealers expected it to recover somewhat to around 695 crowns.
The company earlier said it expected 1996 pre-tax earnings excluding associated earnings to fall to 145 million crowns compared to 1995's 275 million crowns.
It noted losses of 30-40 million crowns in its Electronics and Data division and said that the division's chief had been replaced.--Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
